latest.title: Accelerating data workflows with AI Agents in your IDE
latest.description: Data practitioners today bounce between notebooks, consoles, CLI tools, and dashboards just to go from idea to deployed pipeline — and every context switch costs time and focus. In this session, we'll demo how Kiro, connected to a cloud data environment via SageMaker Unified Studio's Local IDE feature, collapses that multi-tool, multi-tab reality into a single, prompt-driven experience. You'll watch us go from a raw dataset to a governed, queryable asset — all from one IDE, one conversation —

latest.title: From Trading Desk to Cloud Stage: The Trader Builder Group Journey Begins Today
latest.description: I started as a quiet AWS Builder Center blogger, carrying the weight of being an international nobody in a new room. latest.title: Near Real-Time Data Pipelines on AWS: Building a Kappa Architecture with Kinesis and Spark Structured Streaming
latest.description: Most teams reach for streaming before they've confirmed they actually need it. This article is for when the answer is genuinely under 5 minutes. It's a full AWS walkthrough of Kappa Architecture: one unified streaming pipeline using Kinesis Data Streams, Spark Structured Streaming on EMR, and Delta Lake on S3. Covers the three-job chain, checkpointing, watermark placement, why Glue doesn't work at Gold, and the operational concerns most streaming articles skip.

latest.title: Kargo on EKS: A Deep Dive into GitOps Continuous Promotion
latest.description: Kargo fills the "promotion gap" in GitOps: Argo CD syncs state to clusters, but has no opinion on how artifacts move between environments. This post explains how Kargo's Freight, Warehouse, and Stage primitives orchestrate container image promotion through a test → uat → prod pipeline — with practical lessons from a working PoC on EKS.

latest.title: Reasoning Observability on AWS — CloudWatch Metrics for RTD, a Lambda Emitter, and a Three-Layer Agent Dashboard
latest.description: This article implements the reasoning observability layer for AI agents using CloudWatch custom metrics, a Lambda decision trace emitter, and a CloudWatch dashboard that surfaces RTD alongside HER and RSI.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: Dynamic Looping Comes to AWS SAM
trending.description: AWS SAM CLI now supports CloudFormation Language Extensions, bringing Fn::ForEach, Fn::Length, Fn::ToJsonString, FindInMap with default values, and conditional deletion policies to your local development workflow. Define a resource once and generate as many as you need. Build, invoke, validate, package, deploy, and sync all work with language extensions out of the box. This post walks through each extension with working examples and shows how SAM CLI handles dynamic looping end-to-end.
